content: {"reasoning":"The claim was submitted in the correct COB order, so correcting or resubmitting unchanged data would not address the CO-22 denial. A medical-necessity appeal is unrelated to the denial, and the account should not yet be billed to the patient or secondary payer without resolving the erroneous primary-payer determination. No available automated action can properly challenge the payer's COB finding, so specialist review is required.","action":"escalate"}
